title: DeepMMSearch-R1: Empowering Multimodal LLMs in Multimodal Web Search
authors: Kartik Narayan; Yang Xu; Tian Cao; Kavya Nerella; Vishal M. Patel; Navid Shiee; Peter Grasch; Chao Jia; Yinfei Yang; Zhe Gan
why_relevant: Proposes a multimodal search-equipped MLLM with self-reflection and query refinement that handles noisy web search results, tangentially relating to robust retrieval control.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on building a multimodal web-search agent, not on systematically studying robustness, conflict, calibration, or adversarial conditions in RAG.
